mapper.sql: history.id as history_database_id, history.copywriting_approval_history_id, history.copywriting_approval_flow_id, approval_flow.copywriting_id, copywriting.title as copywriting_title, history.operator_id, operator_user.nick_name as operator_name, history.operation_status, history.comment, history.from_status, history.to_status, history.create_time

from t_copywriting_approval_history history inner join t_copywriting_approval_flow approval_flow on approval_flow.copywriting_approval_flow_id = history.copywriting_approval_flow_id inner join t_copywriting copywriting on copywriting.copywriting_id = approval_flow.copywriting_id left join t_user operator_user on operator_user.user_id = history.operator_id
mapper.select: select copywriting.id, copywriting.copywriting_id, copywriting.user_id, copywriting.copywriting_category_id, copywriting.copywriting_source_id, copywriting.title, copywriting.summary, copywriting.content, copywriting.status, copywriting.create_time, copywriting.update_time from t_copywriting copywriting where copywriting.copywriting_id = #{copywritingId}

select count(1) from t_copywriting copywriting inner join t_copywriting_expert_assignment assignment on assignment.account_user_id = copywriting.user_id inner join t_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id = assignment.expert_user_id and coalesce(reviewer.status, 0) = 0 where copywriting.copywriting_id = #{copywritingId} and assignment.expert_user_id = #{viewerUserId} and exists ( select 1 from t_user_role_map role_map inner join t_role role on role.role_id = role_map.role_id where role_map.user_id = #{viewerUserId} and upper(role.name) = 'EXPERT' )

select count(1) from t_copywriting copywriting inner join t_copywriting_organization_admin_assignment assignment on assignment.account_user_id = copywriting.user_id inner join t_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id = assignment.admin_user_id and coalesce(reviewer.status, 0) = 0 where copywriting.copywriting_id = #{copywritingId} and assignment.admin_user_id = #{viewerUserId} and exists ( select 1 from t_user_role_map role_map inner join t_role role on role.role_id = role_map.role_id where role_map.user_id = #{viewerUserId} and upper(role.name) = 'ORG_ADMIN' )
